Good vibrations

The best travel toothbrush!!
I've used Philips Sonicare toothbrushes for many years but when it came to travel I always felt the case was more bulkier than I wanted so i opted for smaller off brands. . The ONE has changed that!! It's perfect. The power and cleaning capabilities of the larger ones but with a  super slim brush and travel case. You can also charge the toothbrush while it's protected in the case and you can use the same charging cable you use for your phone. I've bought several for gifts as well. Not sure how long they'll last but if it's like my other Philips brushes it will run years and years.
My only complaint is all the cool colors only come in the battery operated version ONE and I hate battery operated toothbrushes.
Pros
Portable, compact, powerful , rechargeable
Cons
Not the best color options
Yes, I recommend this product

features.name: Good vibrations
features.description: Think of the One like a manual toothbrush that works harder and faster. 13,000 microvibrations per minute and contoured bristles gently clean your teeth for a whiter, brighter smile.

features.name: The One that goes with you
features.description: The One is made to travel so you can get that clean feeling any place. It’s sleek and lightweight and fits neatly into a compact travel case.

features.name: Routine made easy
features.description: Sometimes, we all need a little guidance. The One buzzes every 30 seconds encouraging you to move on to the next part of your mouth. A longer buzz at 2 minutes lets you know when the job is done.

features.name: A color for every style
features.description: From Shadow to Shimmer, Snow to Sage, choose the color to match your style. You can mix and match the brush head with the handle and create your own color combination.

features.name: One charge, one month of brush
features.description: Charging your One is easy. Just pop off the end cap, plug in your USB-A cable and wait until the light indicator stops flashing. With a single charge, you can brush for 30 days. That's one month of whiter, brighter smiling.

features.name: Keep it fresh
features.description: Dentists recommend changing your brush head every three months for the best results. Philips One brush heads come in a variety of vibrant colors, so you can update your look as well as your brush head every time.
